mentions.name: ShrewDNS
mentions.description: A networking-over-DNS client and server written in Go that exposes DNS channels as UDP endpoints, usable as a building block to tunnel WireGuard, SSH, a SOCKS5 proxy over QUIC (via quicmux), or even Mosh directly over DNS. Also ships with an Android app.
mentions.source_excerpt: A networking-over-DNS client and server, in Go. https://sr.ht/~nullenenenen/ShrewDNS/
mentions.author: Wicher
